title: Topological Torsion Immunity and the Mathlib4 Sheaf Gate: Why Integral Counterexamples Cannot Obstruct the Rational Hodge Conjecture
description: Formal machine-verified Lean 4 proof and adversarial sieve establishing that the rational Hodge conjecture is immune to topological torsion obstructions from Atiyah-Hirzebruch, Kollar, Totaro, and Voisin. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
